# <span id="aanchor274"></span> Report/Export Groups

Use the Report and Export Group Editor to create a group of reports or exports to be used within the Report Scheduler.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Report and Export Group Editor:

1.  Go to **Reports** \> **Report Scheduler** \> **Report/Exports Group**.
2.  Select the group type (Exports or Reports). **Reports** is selected by default.
    1.  Select **Reports** for Crystal reports such as the Volume Statement or Balance Detail report to filter the **Group** drop-down by report groups.
    2.  Select **Exports** for custom or standard exports, such as GasTextFileExchange to filter the **Group** drop-down by export groups.
3.  Click **New** to create a new group.
4.  Enter a group name.
5.  Double-click items in the **Available Reports** list to move them to the **Selected Reports** list. You can also click an available report and click the right arrow button.
6.  Click **Save**.
7.  The new group will now be available from the Schedule Editor when you click the **Group** drop-down menu. In the Schedule Editor, click the **Reports** button next to the Groups drop-down to view a list of reports in this group.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 547;height: 281;" />

</div>

By default, a BLM Audit Package report group has been created that contains the following reports:

- BLM Audit Package Cover Page
- BLM Gas Volume Statement – Daily
- Meter Characteristics
- Meter Events
- Meter Sample and Analysis

This group is not required by the system and can be edited or deleted.

If TESTit 3 Integrated is enabled, the TESTit reports are not displayed; these items are only available from the TESTit application.
